name: preflight-base-diagnosis
title: final-bundle blames every path when the base is wrong
description: When --base includes work commits, final-bundle emits a bundle_scope_invalid finding for each changed path outside .trellis/tasks/ and .trellis/workspace/ -- for deltas of at most 500 changed paths, and only up to the 100-finding cap -- and never names the base as the cause. Observed on a loadsmith pack refresh: 73 findings, zero mentioning the base; re-running with the correct base returned valid with no other change.
creator: sdelmas
